bio.text: Michael Reilly has represented Assembly District 62, which includes Staten Island's South Shore and parts of the Mid-Island, since he was elected on November 6, 2018.
According to his official biography, he enlisted in the U.S. Army Reserve and then served 12 years with the New York City Police Department, retiring as a lieutenant from Brooklyn's 90th Precinct.
He served on Community Education Council 31 from 2009 and as its president from 2014 until his election, and lives in Eltingville, Staten Island.
